1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is not a living tissue.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped.

10. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component.

12. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface for bony ingrowth material on said humeral surface component.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Cancelled)

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper, and a screw.

27. (Currently Amended) A glenohumeral joint implant comprising an implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

30. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
